scope: Known OS vulnerabilities in the actual Azure VM installed-package inventory. Not a full filesystem, secret, runtime exploitability or running-kernel verification.
notes: No findings ignored, suppressed or reclassified.
Every selected finding is mapped through two Ubuntu kernel-source utility packages at version 6.8.0-139.139. This is not proof that each flaw is reachable in the running Azure kernel.
An APT removal simulation would also remove the linux-azure metapackage and eight Azure kernel/tool companions. Removal was rejected to preserve kernel updates and Azure integration.
Native scanning initially received an inventory without etc/lsb-release, reported an unsupported OS and was not accepted as verification. The actual exported release marker corrected OS detection.
Docker scanner startup stalled during a separate Docker Engine issue. Only the two task scanner clients were stopped; Docker Desktop and unrelated containers were not restarted.

vendor_samples.observed: Ubuntu Noble linux and linux-azure vulnerable; Noble linux-azure-6.17 end of life. Verified against the Ubuntu advisory updated 7 September 2026.
Ubuntu Noble linux-azure-6.17 end of life. The record describes KVM/SEV behavior; per-architecture and runtime applicability needs individual assessment.
